respond.direct.use_when: The person asks a question, wants an explanation, ideas, wording help, or just chats, and VOOL can answer from its own knowledge without touching files, apps, the web, or the computer.
examples: explain what a mortgage is in simple terms
what's the difference between affect and effect
can u give me ideas for my sisters birthday
Could you please help me word a polite reply to my landlord?
how many ounces in a cup
whats a good way to stay focused when studying
Summarize the plot of Romeo and Juliet in three sentences.
Donne-moi une idée de dîner rapide pour ce soir
Was ist der Unterschied zwischen 'das' und 'dass'?
not_for: open my calendar and tell me what meetings I have tomorrow
search the internet for today's weather in Vilnius
delete everything in my Downloads folder
send an email to my boss saying I'm sick
set a reminder for 5pm to call mom
read the notes file on my desktop and summarize it
